name: nexus_search_by_md5
description:
Identify an installed file by looking up its MD5 hash [v1 - uses v1 REST quota].
Use the 32-hex MD5 of a local file to find the matching mod and file.

Returns:
    JSON array of {mod: <mod info>, file_details: <file info>}.

domain_name.description: Nexus Mods game domain (lowercase URL slug), e.g. 'forzahorizon6', 'skyrimse'. NOT the display name.
domain_name.title: Domain Name

md5_hash.description: MD5 hash of the file to look up (32 hex characters).
md5_hash.title: Md5 Hash
